fidelity_rule.sample_rule: session s is in the sample iff ``stream(f"n-fid|{s}").random() < 0.10``; every read of a sampled session at a point the dose rule does not cover is re-computed (§2.1: "a 10% keyed sample of the other points, `n-fid|{s}`"; the key is per session, so the sample is a sample of sessions)
